(a) The rate at which water flows into the tank is \( r(t) = 8 - \frac{t}{5} \) gallons per minute, so the amount that has flowed in by time \( t \) is \( R(t) = \int_0^t r(x)\,dx \).

(b) At \( t = 10 \), the total amount is \( R(10) = \int_0^{10} \left( 8 - \frac{x}{5} \right) dx = 80 - 5 = 75 \) gallons.

(c) The tank overflows when \( R(t) = 100 \), so \( 8t - \frac{t^2}{10} = 100 \).

(d) The rate of change of the amount is \( R'(t) = r(t) \), the net flow rate.
